sehemu: Part II: Members of Parliament, Constituencies and Election of Members
maudhui: (1) Whenever Parliament is dissolved, there shall be an election of Members of Parliament in all constituencies. (2) Likewise, there shall be an election of a Member of Parliament in a constituency if the seat of a Member elected to represent that constituency becomes vacant for any reason other than the dissolution of Parliament. (3) Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article, where the date for dissolution of Parliament has been proclaimed or is known by reason of the events specified in Article 90(3), such an election shall not be held during the period of twelve months immediately preceding that date.
vifungu: (1) Whenever Parliament is dissolved, there shall be an election of Members of Parliament in all constituencies.

(2) Likewise, there shall be an election of a Member of Parliament in a constituency if the seat of a Member elected to represent that constituency becomes vacant for any reason other than the dissolution of Parliament.

(3) Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article, where the date for dissolution of Parliament has been proclaimed or is known by reason of the events specified in Article 90(3), such an election shall not be held during the period of twelve months immediately preceding that date.
